IMPORTANT_NOTES: KOREKSI (6 Okt, lepas user double-check): Tarikh window dlm run asal (5 Okt) silap label satu hari - sistem tunjuk 'hari ni 5 Okt' tapi jam sebenar Meta API dah masuk 6 Okt semasa pull dibuat, so 'semalam' yg disimpan sbg '2026-10-04' sebenarnya data 2026-10-05 (nombor DAH BETUL, cuma label tarikh je silap). Dah dibetulkan kat sini. Verified cross-check dgn time_range explicit terus kat Meta API.
Dashboard ni automated & boleh run >1x sehari. total_this_year guna date-guard: hanya tambah data utk hari lepas date terakhir yang dah dikira (idempotent, takkan double-count).
Run ni (2026-10-05) isi gap 12 hari (2026-09-23..2026-10-04) yang tak dipantau sejak run lepas (2026-09-23).
PERUBAHAN BESAR dalam gap: campaign '140926/ENG NEW' & '140926/LEAD new' flip ACTIVE->PAUSED tanpa makluman jelas - perlu owner confirm sama ada sengaja atau auto-pause (budget/policy).

Campaign baru '230926/ENGAGEMENT/LOCATION NEW/ABO' (created 2026-09-23) dah spend lumayan (30D RM1,072.89, 35 leads) - classify NEW/Testing (age 12 hari <14), RED on spend-based sebab run-rate harian ~RM61/hari (purata 7D) jauh lebih RM56.
Campaign baru '061026/ENGAGEMENT/KELAS PETANG/ABO' dibuat HARI NI (2026-10-05), 3 adset x RM20/hari (RM60/hari combined) - belum ada data conversion, monitor je buat masa ni.
Campaign '140926/RETARGETING NEW' kini cukup umur (23 hari) utk reclassify NEW->OLD/Established, CPL-based: 7D RM11.69, 14D RM12.48 - GREEN.
Campaign lama '050626/RETARGETING/WHATSFORM' (PAUSED) muncul balik dalam 30D/last_month pull (RM978.13, 57 leads last_month) - fully dormant sekarang (0 spend Oct), takde di-flag sebagai isu baru.
'210926/LEAD/KELAS FIZIKAL' (P1 flag run lepas) tetap PAUSED & frozen (RM108.65, takde spend baru) - flag tu dah stale/resolved, bukan isu aktif lagi.
'080626/LOCATION new/ABO' & '050626/RETARGETING' tetap PAUSED/frozen (last_month spend sama macam snapshot lepas) - confirm takde spend baru, stable dormant.
'140926/SALES/TESTING' tetap PAUSED, 0 conversion dari dulu (RM74.33 frozen) - campaign mati, boleh pertimbang delete/archive.

Beberapa campaign test lama 2024/awal-Sept (100926, 090926, 070926, 010926) fully dormant (0 spend Oct) - tak masuk dalam section_5 utama sebab dah mati, tapi spend lama diambilkira dalam total_this_year.

Traffic-light spend-based (NEW/Testing) guna purata spend harian 7D (spend_7D/7) sebagai proksi 'pace harian', bukan cumulative 14D mentah - supaya threshold RM0-30/31-55/56+ relevan (kalau guna cumulative 14D mentah semua new ads jadi RED palsu).
'meta_lead' field = Meta 'lead' action standard (bukan WhatsFormSubmit) - kecil & sampingan, CPL basis utama tetap WhatsFormSubmit.
Filtering amount_spent>=20 kat Meta Ads API level ad/campaign tak berfungsi (confirmed bug, berulang dari run lepas) - filter dibuat manual client-side lepas tarik data sorted descending.

flags.suggested_action: Review creative/targeting - CPL 14D RM30.65 agak tinggi utk campaign baru. Pertimbang kurangkan budget sikit sementara optimize, atau pause adset yg underperform (cth VID1-3 dgn CPL RM24-28).
